name: Spider-Woman

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Debilitate: Debilitate dışında yeni uygulanan debuff'ların süresini uzatır.
abilityDetails.Wither: Rakibin güç kazanma ve iyileşme etkilerini zayıflatır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Fumble: Özel saldırılar sırasında Çeviklik ustalığının etkinleşmesini engeller.
abilityDetails.Instant Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Power Sting: Rakip özel saldırı attığında yüksek şok hasarı almasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Retribution: Etkilenen şampiyon özel saldırı kullandığında, özel saldırı bitene kadar tüm kaynaklardan artan hasar alır.
abilityDetails.Energize: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Özel saldırılarda destreza'yı kapatan, purify edilemeyen bir debuff uygulayabilir. E1'i daha sık tetikler ve bloklanırsa güçlü iğne uygular (özel saldırı kullanmanı engeller). Rakipteki her debuff için %2 kaçış şansı kazanır — kaçış-karşıtı şampiyon şart.
signatureAbility:
Hydra Training
When a personal Fury Buff is consumed or Nullified, [10 - 100]% chance to gain an identical Fury Passive. The total amount of personal Fury Buffs and Passives cannot exceed 20.
Intercepting the Opponent has a [10 - 100]% chance to grant a Fury Buff.
While Dodging back during the final hit of the Opponent's Special Attacks, Spider-Woman has a 100% chance to Evade. This Evade does not trigger if the attack is successfully Dodged.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Spider-Woman is immune to Poison, Neutralize, and Power Steal.
All personal effects, except Stun and Power Gain, are paused during any Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Fury Buffs
content: Personal Fury Buffs increase Attack Rating by +[766.5] for 15 seconds. This Buff duration cannot be reduced, and refreshes on an Evade or when Dodging a Special Attack with the Dexterity Mastery. Max stacks: 20.
For every 5 landed Basic Attacks, gain a Fury Buff. When starting a Combo against a non-Stunned Opponent, Critical Hits count as 2 hits.
When struck, 20% chance to gain a Fury Buff.

abilitySections.title: Debuffs
content: When Spider-Woman gains a Buff, inflict an 8.33% Debilitate Debuff for 20 seconds. Max stacks: 6. Against Mystic Champions, this Debuff becomes a Severe Debuff.

When a Buff on Spider-Woman is Nullified, Staggered, or expires naturally, inflict a non-stacking 50% Wither Debuff for 1 second. When this Wither ends, she gains a Power Gain Passive granting her the Power denied while it was active over 5 seconds.

Every 15 seconds, inflict a 100% Severe Fumble Debuff for 7 seconds. This timer pauses during Spider-Woman's Special Attacks, and as Defender, this Debuff cannot be inflicted during the Opponent's Special Attacks. Whilte this Fumble is active, Spider-Woman's attacks cannot be Evaded.
As a Defender, when the Opponent activates a Special Attack, Fumble is removed. Additionally, Spider-Woman is more likely to use Special Attack 1 while Fumble is active.

abilitySections.title: Venom Blasts
content: Personal Shock are Instants and deal a burst of [766.5] Energy Damage.
When a Buff on Spider-Woman is Nullified, inflict 2 instant Shocks.
When Spider-Woman inflicts a Shock or has one prevented by an Immunity, inflict a [3,613.5] Severe Power Sting Debuff for 10 seconds. As a Defender, Power Stings last for 7 seconds.

Power Stings deal an additional Burst of [1,533] Direct Damage when they trigger, scaling up with how much Power and number of bars of Power the Opponent had. As a Defender, this damage scales with Base Attack only.

abilitySections.title: Evade
content: For each non-Damaging Debuff on both Champions, Spider-Woman has a +2% chance to Evade incoming attacks, up to a max of 24%. This Evade does not trigger while Blocking.

When an attack strikes an Unstoppable Opponent or Misses, gain a 100% Evade Buff for 2 seconds. An Evade from this Buff can trigger while Blocking, and when it triggers, this effect goes on cooldown for 10 seconds or until a Buff on Spider-Woman is Nullified or she is Immune to an effect.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit inflicts an instant Shock, and consumes a Buff on Spider-Woman to inflict a second Shock. These can be inflicted through Block.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain 5 Fury Buffs and refresh all Buffs on Spider-Woman.
The final hit inflicts a non-stacking 100% Retribution Passive for 20 seconds. When an attack strikes an Unstoppable Opponent or Misses, this effect refreshes.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict 15 instant Shocks.
Inflict a Stun Passive for 4 seconds.
Gain a non-stacking 33% Energize Buff for 10 seconds.
